critical_code_review_comments: Detail.jsx L138 Block component still uses key={i} on items.map((x,i)=><li key={i}>) — the review request explicitly listed 'Detail Block tag lists' as fixed with stable keys. Items are strings (specializations/tags), so key={x} would be the intended stable key. Very minor — items are static per render so no visible bug, but the fix is incomplete relative to what was claimed.

backend_test.py test_payment_paid_flow used registration_fee=10.0 which, with CURRENCY=inr, converts to ~USD $0.10 — below Stripe's 50-cent minimum, causing a 500 (CheckoutError). This is a pre-existing test-data drift from Phase 2's currency switch to INR. Bumped to 500.0 in the test. Backend behavior itself is correct — it surfaces Stripe's error as 500. Consider translating Stripe CheckoutError to 400 with a user-friendly message and/or enforcing a minimum registration_fee at model validation.
test_phase2.py::test_payment_status_creates_registration_on_paid returns a str value (PytestReturnNotNoneWarning). Change the trailing `return sid` to a plain assert to silence the warning.
Carried over from iter 2: server.py L785 CORS allow_origins=['*'] + allow_credentials=True — browsers ignore Set-Cookie; Bearer path works but cookie SPA login is effectively disabled.
